versions.changelog:
- Updated dependencies in package.json for improved stability.
- Minor code improvements in magazinecovergenerator.js.
- Documentation in README.md updated for clarity.

- Initial release of Magazine Cover Generator.
- Generate AI magazine cover art in Vogue, TIME, GQ, and editorial styles.
- Supports professional masthead typography and cover headlines.
- Customize output with options for size and reference image.
- Requires a Neta API token (free trial available).
- Easy installation and quick start with provided Bash commands.
